idleBootPolicy: No serial write is required without a key stimulus; transmit scenarios are separate

serialTransport.scope: Bit transport only; no S600 frame or key-semantics claim from matching intent

cpuClockVoltage.scope: Sampled excursions within the published supply range only; does not qualify pulse widths, between-sample behavior, temperature, or CPU behavior below that range
cpuClockVoltage.resetBoundary: Complete numerical clock cycles with sampled reset low, counted separately for each contiguous rated-supply interval. Not reset pulse-width, CPU state-retention or restart qualification.

cycles.boundary: Complete cycles delimited by rising 1.4 V numerical crossings; leading/trailing partial cycles are not assessed. No pulse-width or slew claim.

cpuClockTiming.scope: Sample-bracket comparison using clock valid-input voltage limits; no interpolation, between-sample waveform proof, specimen speed-grade assignment or tester-threshold calibration
cpuClockTiming.partialIntervalPolicy: Intervals clipped by file endpoints, invalid supply or out-of-range clock voltage are excluded; transitions with both observed brackets may still be assessed
